item.title: Light and ultrasound reveal renewable routes to compounds for pharmaceutical research
item.description: Sustainable packaging is only the beginning. What a medicine is made from—and how its ingredients are produced—matters just as much. Yet the synthesis of compounds for pharmaceutical research can still depend on fossil feedstocks, high temperatures, strong oxidants and metals that raise costs and complicate purification. Two recently published studies from Colmenares' group at IPC PAS demonstrate that cleaner chemistry can begin at the level of a single chemical bond. The studies are published in the journal Ultrasonics Sonochemistry and Chemistry—A European Journal. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: World-record intensity in attosecond hard-X-ray pulses could unlock closer study of electrons in atoms and molecules
item.description: Researchers used the European XFEL to create X-ray flashes that were not only extremely short but also reached record intensity for this type of pulse. The researchers focused the X-rays to an area roughly 100,000 times smaller than the cross section of a typical human hair. This concentrated the X-ray light into a tiny but extremely powerful spot. The method could enable detailed studies of how electrons behave in atoms and molecules and, in the long term, could even allow researchers to control electrons during chemical reactions. item.title: US journalist injured during Israeli settler attack on West Bank olive harvest
item.description: About 80 Israeli settlers set fire to olive trees and threw stones at Palestinians in a West Bank village Friday, injuring at least two people, including a US photojournalist with The Washington Post. The coordinated attack came as violence by settlers is on the rise during the olive harvest in the occupied Palestinian territory. Publicado también por: BBC News - World. item.title: Protestas universitarias en Argentina exigen que se cumpla la ley de financiamiento
item.description: Ciudadanos salieron a las calles de Buenos Aires por quinta vez para exigir al Gobierno de Javier Milei que cumpla la vigente ley de financiamiento universitario que actualizaría sueldos y valores de becas. Aunque fue aprobada en 2025 y confirmada por el Congreso tras un veto presidencial, el Ejecutivo no la aplicó. La movilización terminó con enfrentamientos entre la Policía y algunos manifestantes, dejando un saldo de algunos heridos. Fuente: France 24 - Español.
